description: Frozen synthetic holdout before scoring. Twenty new household/hobby topics, bilingual paraphrases and twelve unknown questions. Not used to choose cutoff or ranking. No user data.

records.text: 家里的水族箱只养淡水鱼，每周六换三分之一的水。
做面包时我使用黑麦粉，发酵需要十二小时。
观鸟望远镜是八倍放大，口径四十二毫米。
唱片机的针压设为两克，唱片转速是每分钟三十三转。
堆肥箱放在阳台，厨房果皮和落叶混合后放进去。
练钢琴先做十分钟音阶练习，再弹肖邦的作品。
我的天文望远镜用一百五十毫米口径的反射镜。
羊毛围巾只能用冷水手洗，并平铺晾干。
仙人掌每月浇水一次，冬季停止施肥。
制作陶器用红陶土，窑炉最高温度为一千零八十摄氏度。
My handmade quilt uses cotton batting and a diamond stitching pattern.
My film camera is loaded with ISO 400 black-and-white film.
I tap the maple tree only when nights freeze and daytime temperatures rise above zero.
My preferred chess opening as White is the Queen's Gambit.
The kayak paddle is 220 centimeters long and uses a low-angle blade.
I sew denim with a size 100 needle and polyester thread.
For origami cranes I cut square paper with sides of fifteen centimeters.
My sourdough starter is fed twice daily with equal weights of water and flour.
I clean the trumpet valves with lukewarm water and never use abrasive brushes.
My jigsaw puzzle has two thousand pieces and depicts a mountain waterfall.
